description: A bit crusher and downsampler with modulation inputs and triggers that throw new rates at random

params.text: Sets the bit depth the signal is quantised to, 1 to 16 bits
Attenuates the voltage at the bit rate modulation input before it is added to the bit depth, 0 to 100%
Sets the rate the signal is held at, 0.44Hz to 44100Hz
Attenuates the voltage at the sample rate modulation input before it is added to the sample rate, 0 to 100%

inputs.text: Modulates the bit depth, attenuated by the MOD knob for bit rate and clamped between 1 and 16 bits
A gate throws a new bit depth between 1 and 8 bits, and overrides the BITS knob while a cable is here
Modulates the sample rate, attenuated by the MOD knob for sample rate
A gate throws a new sample rate, and overrides the SAMP knob while a cable is here
The signal to be crushed and downsampled; with no cable here nothing is processed

outputs.text: The crushed and downsampled signal, -5V to +5V

notes: nothing comes out until a signal is patched into the input.
